overview_description.description:
Lyra helps companies improve access to effective, high-quality mental health care for their employees.

Lyra's matching technology and innovative digital platform connect members to a curated network of top therapists and coaches, which results in 3x more people receiving care and 7x better outcomes than traditional plans and EAPs. Members can find the right personalized care, match with the right provider for their needs, and feel motivated and supported throughout the entire treatment journey.

product.name: Lyra Care
product.description: An employer-sponsored mental health care service providing preventive support, coaching, therapy, psychiatry, medication management, and care navigation through digital and in-person channels.

product.name: Lyra Empower
product.description: A workforce mental health platform for employers that combines care access, workforce well-being tools, reporting, and resources for implementing organizational mental health strategies.

product.name: Lyra AI
product.description: A clinically governed mental health AI capability that supports member triage, provider matching, care coordination, and personalized guidance alongside human clinicians.

product.name: Lyra Select
product.description: An EAP replacement service focused on everyday mental health and well-being, combining self-guided resources, workshops, coaching, therapy, provider matching, and crisis support.

identifier.value: Specialty and High-Acuity Mental Health Care

product.name: Specialty and High-Acuity Mental Health Care
product.description: Specialized behavioral health services for complex or severe needs, including substance use, suicidality, addiction, neurodiversity, pediatric conditions, and transitions to higher levels of care.

identifier.value: Global Provider Network and Care Navigation

product.name: Global Provider Network and Care Navigation
product.description: A distributed network of vetted mental health providers and navigators that helps members locate appropriate care, schedule appointments, and transition between services.
